Consult the Spirits.name: Consult the Spirits
Consult the Spirits.description:
You gain the ability to consult with your guardian spirits. When you do so, you cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplAugury0000]{Augury} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplClairvoyan]{Clairvoyance} spell without expending a spell slot or needing Material components. Rather than creating a spherical sensor, this use of Clairvoyance invisibly summons one of your guardian spirits to the chosen location. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

After you cast either spell in this way, you can’t use this feature again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

Echo of the Elements.name: Echo of the Elements
Echo of the Elements.description: You tap into the tranquility of the elements. You know the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplElementali]{Elementalism} cantrip. In addition, you can expend a use of your Rage to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDaylight00]{Daylight}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWaterWalk0]{Water Walk}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWindWall00]{Wind Wall}. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

Elemental Overload.name: Elemental Overload
Elemental Overload.description:
The power of the storm you channel grows mightier, lashing out at your foes. Your Raging Elements options gain the following effects.

Icefury. Whether or not you hit the target with this option, the target subtracts half the number rolled (round down) from the next damage roll it makes before the start of your next turn.

Lava Burst. Whether or not the target fails its saving throw against this option, the target and each enemy within 10 feet of it start burning.

Lightning Bolt. Whether or not the target fails its saving throw against this option, a bolt of lightning leaps from the target to another target of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of the first target. The new target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Lightning damage equal to the roll’s total on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Path of the Elements.name: Path of the Elements
Path of the Elements.description:
Wield the Fury of the Elements

Barbarians who follow the Path of the Elements learn to harness their Rage into a storm of flames, frost, and lightning. When in their Rage, these Barbarians tap into the elemental forces of nature to create powerful magical effects.

Path of the Spiritual Guardian.name: Path of the Spiritual Guardian
Path of the Spiritual Guardian.description:
Call on the Spirits for Combat Aid

Barbarians who walk the Path of the Spiritual Guardian call on spirits—whether bestial spirits of nature, spirits of departed ancestors, or spirits of raw elemental power—to guide and protect them. When these Barbarians rage, they contact the realm of the spirits and call on them for aid.

Primordial Bond.name: Primordial Bond
Primordial Bond.description: While your Rage is active, you have Resistance to Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage.

Primordial Bond.name: Primordial Bond
Primordial Bond.description: You have Resistance to Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage.

Raging Elements.name: Raging Elements
Raging Elements.description:
Whenever you activate your Rage, you can take one of the following Raging Elements options of your choice as part of that Bonus Action. While your rage is active, you can take a Bonus Action to use that option again or a different option.

If a Raging Elements option requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus.

Icefury.name: Icefury
Icefury.description: When this effect is activated, roll a number of d8s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. You hurl frigid ice at one creature within 30 feet of yourself. Make either a melee spell attack (if the target is within 5 feet) or a ranged spell attack, using Constitution as your spellcasting ability. On a hit, the attack deals Cold damage equal to the number rolled, and the next time the target takes Fire damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an extra 1d10 Fire damage.

Icefury: Extra Damage.name: Icefury: Extra Damage
Icefury: Extra Damage.condition: When a target hit by Icefury takes Fire damage before the end of your next turn
Icefury: Extra Damage.description: The next time the target takes Fire damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an extra 1d10 Fire damage.

Lava Burst.name: Lava Burst
Lava Burst.description: When this effect is activated, roll a number of d4s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. You then hurl molten lava at one creature you can see within 30 feet. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes Fire damage equal to the number rolled, and the next time the target takes Lightning damage until the end of your next turn, it takes an extra 1d8 Lightning damage. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

Lava Burst: Extra Damage.name: Lava Burst: Extra Damage
Lava Burst: Extra Damage.condition: When a target hit by Lava Burst takes Lightning damage before the end of your next turn
Lava Burst: Extra Damage.description: The next time the target takes Lightning damage until the end of your next turn, it takes an extra 1d8 Lightning damage.

Lightning Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description: When this effect is activated, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. You can then hurl a bolt of lightning at one other creature you can see within 30 feet. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes Lightning damage equal to the roll’s total, and the next time the target takes Cold damage until the end of your next turn, it takes an extra 1d6 Cold damage. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

Lightning Bolt: Extra Damage.name: Lightning Bolt: Extra Damage
Lightning Bolt: Extra Damage.condition: When a target hit by Lightning Bolt takes Cold damage before the end of your next turn
Lightning Bolt: Extra Damage.description: The next time the target takes Cold damage until the end of your next turn, it takes an extra 1d6 Cold damage.

Spirits' Fury.name: Spirits' Fury
Spirits' Fury.description: Your spirits hasten your attacks. When you make an attack roll with a Melee weapon as part of the &Reference[Attack] action and roll 18–20 on the d20, you can make one additional attack roll with the same weapon as part of that action. Once you use this feature, you can’t do so again until the start of your next turn.

Spiritual Protectors.name: Spiritual Protectors
Spiritual Protectors.description:
Your Rage summons spectral warriors to your aid. While your Rage is active, when you hit a creature with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, that creature becomes a target of the spirits, which cause one of the following effects of your choice.

Distract.name: Distract
Distract.condition: When you hit a creature with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike while your Rage is active
Distract.description: Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another Barbarian who has this feature.

Hinder.name: Hinder
Hinder.condition: When you hit a creature with a weapon and deal damage to it while your Rage is active.
Hinder.description: You can activate the &Reference[Slow] mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you’re using with that weapon.

Strike.name: Strike
Strike.condition: When you hit a creature with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike while your Rage is active
Strike.description: The target takes an extra 1d4 damage, which can be Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (your choice).

Distracted.name: Distracted
Distracted.description: The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another Barbarian who has this feature.

Spirit Shield.name: Spirit Shield
Spirit Shield.description: Your guardian spirits can provide supernatural protection to those you defend. While your Rage is active, when another creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can take a Reaction to reduce that damage. To determine the amount the damage is reduced by, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together.

Reduce Damage.name: Reduce Damage
Reduce Damage.condition: When another creature you can see takes damage while your Rage is active

Totem.name: Totem
Totem.description:
You can coalesce elemental spirits into a totem that aids you and your allies. As a Bonus Action, you can plant one of the totems below into the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of yourself.

A totem is a Small object that has AC 10 and 1 Hit Point and lasts for 1 minute, until it drops to 0 Hit Points, or until you use this feature again. At the end of each of your turns, the totem pulses with elemental energy that fills a 30-foot Emanation.

Earthbind Totem.name: Earthbind Totem
Earthbind Totem.condition: At the end of your turn while the totem is placed
Earthbind Totem.description: Each enemy in the Emanation has its &Reference[Speed] reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

Primal Knowledge Totem.name: Primal Knowledge Totem
Primal Knowledge Totem.condition: At the end of your turn while the totem is placed
Primal Knowledge Totem.description: Each ally in the Emanation is empowered with nature’s focus until the end of your next turn. While empowered in this way, whenever the creature makes an ability check using one of the following skills, the creature can make it as a Strength check even if it normally uses a different ability: Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival. After you plant this totem, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of this totem by expending one use of your Rage (no action required).

Tremor Totem.name: Tremor Totem
Tremor Totem.condition: At the end of your turn while the totem is placed
Tremor Totem.description: Each ally in the Emanation has Immunity to the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] and &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions until the end of your next turn. If the creature was already Charmed or Frightened, those conditions are suppressed until the end of its next turn.

Wind Rush Totem.name: Wind Rush Totem
Wind Rush Totem.condition: At the end of your turn while the totem is placed
Wind Rush Totem.description: Each ally in the Emanation has its &Reference[Speed] increased by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

Recover Primal Knowledge.name: Recover Primal Knowledge
Recover Primal Knowledge.description: You can also restore your use of the Primal Knowledge Totem by expending one use of your Rage (no action required).

Atonement.name: Atonement
Atonement.description: When a level 1+ spell you cast restores Hit Points to one or more creatures, each of those creatures gains a blessing that lasts until the end of your next turn. Whenever you cast a spell that deals damage to a creature using a spell slot, each blessed creature regains additional Hit Points equal to the level of the spell slot you used to cast the damaging spell.

Grant Blessing.name: Grant Blessing
Grant Blessing.condition: When a level 1+ spell you cast restores Hit Points

heal.condition: When you cast a spell that deals damage to a creature using a spell slot
heal.description: Whenever you cast a spell that deals damage to a creature using a spell slot, each blessed creature regains additional Hit Points equal to the level of the spell slot you used to cast the damaging spell.

Blessing of Atonement.name: Blessing of Atonement
Blessing of Atonement.description: Whenever you cast a spell that deals damage to a creature using a spell slot, each blessed creature regains additional Hit Points equal to the level of the spell slot you used to cast the damaging spell.

Devouring Plague.name: Devouring Plague
Devouring Plague.description:
When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw, you can cause that creature to take 1d10 Necrotic damage. If you do, you regain Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

damage.condition: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw

Discipline Domain.name: Discipline Domain
Discipline Domain.description:
Cure Allies’ Wounds While Smiting Enemies

The Discipline Domain focuses on the balance between the Holy Light and its shadowy mirror, the Void. Wielding both powers at once, Clerics who embrace this domain aid their allies and harm their foes, often with a single spell.

Dispersion.name: Dispersion
Dispersion.description:
When you are hit by an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to disperse into shadowy energy. Until the end of your next turn, you have Resistance to all damage (including the damage from the triggering attack); you can’t take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction; and you have a Fly Speed of 40 feet. When the effect ends, you can spend up to half of your total Hit Point Dice, regaining Hit Points as if you had finished a Short Rest.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

Disperse.name: Disperse
Disperse.condition: When you are hit by an attack roll

heal.description: When the effect ends, you can spend up to half of your total Hit Point Dice, regaining Hit Points as if you had finished a Short Rest.

Holy Bolt.name: Holy Bolt
Holy Bolt.description: As a Bonus Action, you present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to make a ranged spell attack, hurling a bolt of holy energy targeting one creature within 60 feet of yourself. On a hit, the target takes Radiant damage equal to 2d10 plus your Wisdom modifier, and you can choose a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Wisdom modifier.

heal.condition: when you hit with Holy Bolt

Ascending Volley.name: Ascending Volley
Ascending Volley.description: When you use Holy Bolt, you can expend a spell slot as part of the Bonus Action to hurl a number of additional bolts equal to the spell slot level expended. You can direct the bolts to hit one creature or several. Make a separate attack roll for each bolt.

Ascending Step.name: Ascending Step
Ascending Step.condition: When you use Holy Bolt before you make an attack roll
Ascending Step.description: When you use Holy Bolt, you can teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet before you make an attack roll.

Luminous Barrier.name: Luminous Barrier
Luminous Barrier.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of your Channel Divinity to place a magical ward of glowing light on each creature blessed by your Atonement. Each affected creature gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Cleric level plus your Wisdom modifier. While a creature has Temporary Hit Points gained from this feature, it has Resistance to all damage.

Foundry Note

Foundry does not link the Resistance effect to the Temporary Hit Points. Remove the effect manually when those Temporary Hit Points are depleted or replaced.

Shadow Domain.name: Shadow Domain
Shadow Domain.description:
Draw on the Debilitating Power of the Void

The Shadow Domain deals with the powers of shadow and the Void—a sinister mirror of the life-giving powers of the Light. Clerics who embrace these powers can wither their enemies’ flesh and debilitate their minds.

Shadowform.name: Shadowform
Shadowform.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of your Channel Divinity to take on a shadowy form that grants you the following benefits:

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.classes.Item.wowclcShadowform.Activity.b6dS7cbuNdaTvpIC caption=false cite=false classes="subfeature" nameStyle=inline]

The form lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), if you have the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition, or if you deal Radiant damage with a spell.

Shadow Stealth.name: Shadow Stealth
Shadow Stealth.condition: While in Dim Light or Darkness
Shadow Stealth.description: While you are in an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can take the &Reference[Hide] action as a Bonus Action.

Void Empowerment.name: Void Empowerment
Void Empowerment.description: When you cast a spell using a spell slot that deals Psychic or Necrotic damage, you can add 1d6 to one damage roll of the spell.

Vampiric Embrace.name: Vampiric Embrace
Vampiric Embrace.condition: When you roll 1d6 to add extra damage to a spell
Vampiric Embrace.description: While your Shadowform is active, whenever you roll 1d6 to add extra damage to a spell, one creature of your choice within 30 feet of you regains that many Hit Points.

Ultimate Penitence.name: Ultimate Penitence
Ultimate Penitence.description:
Your Holy Bolt grows more powerful as detailed below.

Vampiric Embrace.description: While your Shadowform is active, whenever you roll 1d6 to add extra damage to a spell, one creature of your choice within 30 feet of you regains that many Hit Points.

Call of the Void.name: Call of the Void
Call of the Void.description:
Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.classes.Item.wowinvPactLegion]{Pact of the Legion} Invocation

When you cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFindFamili]{Find Familiar} using Pact of the Legion, you can choose to summon a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowFelImpEEKWKFi]{Fel Imp} familiar or a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowVoidwalkerBzr]{Voidwalker} (see chapter 7 for both stat blocks). In addition, you gain the following benefits.

Quick Attack.description: As a Bonus Action, you can command the familiar to take the &Reference[Attack] action.

Shadow Shield.name: Shadow Shield
Shadow Shield.condition: When your Voidwalker familiar takes damage
Shadow Shield.description: When your Voidwalker familiar takes damage, you can take a Reaction to grant it &Reference[Resistance] against that damage.

Find Familiar: Void.name: Find Familiar: Void
Find Familiar: Void.description: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFindFamili]{Find Familiar}, you can choose to summon a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowFelImpEEKWKFi]{Fel Imp} familiar or a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowVoidwalkerBzr]{Voidwalker}. Curse of Corruption.name: Curse of Corruption
Curse of Corruption.description:
Prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock

When an enemy starts its turn cursed by a Warlock spell you cast (such as @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHex0000000]{Hex}), it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or take Necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

save.condition: When an enemy starts its turn cursed by a Warlock spell you cast

Expendable Minions.name: Expendable Minions
Expendable Minions.description:
Prerequisite: Level 9+ Warlock

When your familiar or a summoned creature you control dies, you or another creature within 60 feet of you regains Hit Points equal to your Warlock level plus your Charisma modifier.

heal.condition: When your familiar or a summoned creature you control dies

Health Funnel.name: Health Funnel
Health Funnel.description:
Prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock

As a Bonus Action, you can expend any number of your unexpended Hit Dice to roll those dice, add your Charisma modifier to each die, and total the rolls. Your familiar or another Fiend you command gains that many Temporary Hit Points.

heal.target: Your familiar or another Fiend you command

Legion Summoning.name: Legion Summoning
Legion Summoning.description:
Prerequisite: Level 9+ Warlock, Pact of the Legion Invocation

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplPlanarBind]{Planar Binding} without expending a spell slot. When you do, you summon a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowFelguardtHf0N]{Felguard}, a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowFelhoundNi2CR]{Felhound}, an @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmIncubus0000000]{Incubus}, or a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmSuccubus000000]{Succubus}, and that Fiend becomes the target of the spell. (Felguards and felhounds are described in chapter 7.) Once you cast the spell in this way, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

summon.condition: When you cast Planar Binding using this invocation

Master Demonologist.name: Master Demonologist
Master Demonologist.description:
Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock

Any Fiends you command also deal extra damage to the target of your @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHex0000000]{Hex} spell as if they were you.

Pact of the Legion.name: Pact of the Legion
Pact of the Legion.description:
You learn the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFindFamili]{Find Familiar} spell and can cast it as a &Reference[Magic] action without expending a spell slot. When you cast the spell, you summon a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowFelImpEEKWKFi]{Fel Imp} familiar (see chapter 7).

Additionally, when you take the &Reference[Attack] action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack with its Reaction.

Find Familiar: Legion.name: Find Familiar: Legion
Find Familiar: Legion.description:
When you cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFindFamili]{Find Familiar}, you summon a Fel Imp familiar.

Additionally, when you take the &Reference[Attack] action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack with its Reaction.

Modify Find Familiar.name: Modify Find Familiar
Modify Find Familiar.hint: When you cast Find Familiar, you summon a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowFelImpEEKWKFi]{Fel Imp} familiar

Blue Lightning.name: Blue Lightning
Blue Lightning.description: Whenever you take a Reaction that isn’t making an &Reference[Opportunity Attacks]{Opportunity Attack} or casting a spell, you can make one Unarmed Strike as part of that Reaction.

Bonus Proficiencies.name: Bonus Proficiencies
Bonus Proficiencies.description: You gain proficiency in the Performance skill, or if you already have it, you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice from the skills available to Monks at level 1. You also gain proficiency with Brewer’s Supplies if you don’t already have it.

Warrior of Mystic Brews.name: Warrior of Mystic Brews
Warrior of Mystic Brews.description:
Drink Mystic Brews to Overwhelm and Confound Foes

Warriors of Mystic Brews move with the jerky, unpredictable movements typical of someone who is intoxicated. Their apparently erratic stumbles conceal a carefully executed dance of blocks, parries, advances, attacks, and retreats. Warriors of Mystic Brews frequent bars and taverns to gather information or spy on potential threats. These warriors drink magical concoctions that enhance their martial arts.

Warriors of Mystic Brews often enjoy playing the fool to bring gladness to the downtrodden or to teach humility to the arrogant, but these Monks are maddening, masterful foes in battle.

Cinnamon Dragon.name: Cinnamon Dragon
Cinnamon Dragon.description: You can take a Magic action to exhale toxic flames in a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Wisdom modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes Fire damage equal to four rolls of your Martial Arts die and has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

Drunkard's Luck.name: Drunkard's Luck
Drunkard's Luck.description: You gain &Reference[Inspiration]{Heroic Inspiration} if you don’t already have it. In addition, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration when you make an ability check or saving throw without it.

Drunken Technique.name: Drunken Technique
Drunken Technique.description: You twist and turn quickly as you move. Whenever you expend a Focus Point using Patient Defense, your Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the current turn, and you can make one Unarmed Strike immediately after the Bonus Action.

utility.condition: When you expend a Focus Point using Patient Defense

Heavenly Spirit.name: Heavenly Spirit
Heavenly Spirit.description: You gain Resistance to two of the following damage types of your choice: Cold, Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage.

Intoxicated Frenzy.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
Intoxicated Frenzy.description: Immediately after you use your Patient Defense, you can move up to your Speed. During this movement, whenever you enter a space within 5 feet of a creature, you can make an Unarmed Strike targeting that creature. In addition, when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike granted by this feature, the creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the &Reference[Prone] condition. A creature can be targeted by an Unarmed Strike granted by this feature only once per turn.

Knock Prone.name: Knock Prone
Knock Prone.condition: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike granted by Intoxicated Frenzy

Master Brewer.name: Master Brewer
Master Brewer.description: When you create a magical beverage using your Mystic Brew feature, you can choose two different options and produce one magical beverage. Drinking the beverage provides the effects of both options for the duration.

Mystic Brew.name: Mystic Brew
Mystic Brew.description:
Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest while holding Brewer’s Supplies, you can use that tool to magically produce one magical beverage, chosen from the following options: Cinnamon Dragon, Heavenly Spirit, or Refreshing Dip. A pint of the beverage appears in a bottle or flask you are holding or carrying; otherwise, the beverage spills out on the ground and then vanishes. If any beverage remains when you finish a Short or Long Rest, the beverage vanishes.

Drinking a Magical Beverage. Only you can gain the benefits of drinking the beverage. You must drink the full pint of the beverage before gaining its benefit. You can spend 1 minute drinking the beverage. You then gain the benefits of the beverage for 1 hour or until you drink another magical beverage, as described below:

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.classes.Item.wowmnkHeavenSpir caption=false nameStyle=inline classes="subfeature"]

Enhancing a Magical Beverage. When you create a magical beverage, you can expend 1 Focus Point to extend the benefits’ duration to 8 hours.

Refreshing Dip.name: Refreshing Dip
Refreshing Dip.description: You have a pool of dice of the same type as your Martial Arts die. The maximum number of dice equals your Wisdom modifier plus half your Monk level (round down). Whenever you regain Hit Points, you can expend and roll one die from this pool to regain additional Hit Points equal to the number rolled.

Stumbling Monk.name: Stumbling Monk
Stumbling Monk.description: When you take a Bonus Action other than Patient Defense, you can also use Patient Defense immediately after that Bonus Action.

Tipsy Sway.name: Tipsy Sway
Tipsy Sway.description:
You can move in sudden, swaying ways. You gain the following benefits.

Leap to Your Feet. When you have the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition, you can stand up by spending 5 feet of movement.

Redirect Attack.name: Redirect Attack
Redirect Attack.condition: When an enemy misses you with a melee attack roll
Redirect Attack.description: When an enemy misses you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reaction and spend 1 Focus Point to cause that attack to hit one creature of your choice, other than the attacker, that you can see within 5 feet of yourself.

Wizened Brewer.description:

Battle Shout.name: Battle Shout
Battle Shout.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to shout encouragement to allies within 30 feet of you that can hear you. Until the start of your next turn, each affected ally adds the Superiority Die to the damage roll the next time it hits with a melee attack.

Demoralizing Shout.name: Demoralizing Shout
Demoralizing Shout.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to shout, demoralizing enemies within 30 feet of you that can hear you. Until the end of your next turn, each affected enemy subtracts the Superiority Die from the damage roll the next time it hits a target other than you with a melee attack.

Heroic Leap.name: Heroic Leap
Heroic Leap.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to jump a number of feet up to your Strength score. Creatures within 5 feet of you when you land make a Strength saving throw, taking Bludgeoning damage equal to the Superiority Die roll on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Mortal Strike.name: Mortal Strike
Mortal Strike.description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to prevent the target from healing. Add the Superiority Die to the attack’s damage roll. The target can’t regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.

Strike.name: Strike
Strike.condition: When you hit a creature with an attack roll

Warding Maneuver.name: Warding Maneuver
Warding Maneuver.description: When you or a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend one Superiority Die if you’re wielding a Melee weapon or a Shield. Add the Superiority Die to the target’s AC against the triggering attack. If the attack still hits, the target has Resistance against the attack’s damage.

Ward.name: Ward
Ward.condition: When you or a creature you can see within 5 feet is hit by an attack roll while you are wielding a Melee weapon or a Shield.

Aspect of the Horsemen.name: Aspect of the Horsemen
Aspect of the Horsemen.description:
As a Bonus Action, you gain the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

Generate Runic Power. You can restore a use of your Runic Mastery by expending a level 4 spell slot (no action required).

Runeforging. When you use your Runic Power and Runic Mastery features, you can choose any effect, not just the one that corresponds to the rune inscribed on your weapon.

Generate Runic Power.name: Generate Runic Power
Generate Runic Power.description: You can restore a use of your Runic Mastery by expending a level 4 spell slot (no action required).

Aura of Deathly Endurance.name: Aura of Deathly Endurance
Aura of Deathly Endurance.description: You and your allies have Resistance to Cold, Necrotic, and Psychic damage while in your Aura of Protection.

Beacon of Light.name: Beacon of Light
Beacon of Light.description: As a &Reference[Magic] action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to wrap an ally within 60 feet in holy energy. For 1 minute, anytime you heal a creature other than the affected ally with a spell or your Lay On Hands, the chosen ally also regains half as many Hit Points.

Holy Energy.name: Holy Energy
Holy Energy.description: Anytime you heal a creature other than the affected ally with a spell or your Lay On Hands, the chosen ally also regains half as many Hit Points.

Blood Rune.name: Blood Rune
Blood Rune.description: When you inscribe this rune on your weapon, and whenever you finish a Long Rest while the rune is inscribed on your weapon, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Paladin level. While you are wielding your inscribed weapon, you gain these Temporary Hit Points whenever you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points.

Temporary Hit Points.name: Temporary Hit Points
Temporary Hit Points.condition: When you inscribe this run, finish a Long Rest, or reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points with this weapon

Death Coil.name: Death Coil
Death Coil.description:
Your creature type becomes Undead.

You also gain the ability to manipulate negative energy. You have a pool of d8s to fuel this ability. The number of dice in the pool equals one plus your Charisma modifier (minimum of one die).

As a Bonus Action, you can target a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself and force it to make a Constitution saving throw, expending dice from the pool. The maximum number of dice you can expend at once equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of one die). Roll the dice you expend. The target takes Necrotic damage equal to the roll’s total on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is an Undead, you can choose to have it regain Hit Points equal to the roll’s total instead. Your pool regains all expended dice when you finish a Long Rest.

The target takes Necrotic damage equal to the roll’s total on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is an Undead, you can choose to have it regain Hit Points equal to the roll’s total instead.

Heal Undead.name: Heal Undead
Heal Undead.description: As a Bonus Action, you can target a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself and force it to make a Constitution saving throw, expending dice from the pool. The maximum number of dice you can expend at once equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of one die). Roll the dice you expend. The target takes Necrotic damage equal to the roll’s total on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is an Undead, you can choose to have it regain Hit Points equal to the roll’s total instead.

Improved Heal Undead.name: Improved Heal Undead
Improved Heal Undead.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can target a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself and force it to make a Constitution saving throw, expending dice from the pool. The maximum number of dice you can expend at once equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of one die). Roll the dice you expend. The target takes Necrotic damage equal to the roll’s total on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is an Undead, you can choose to have it regain Hit Points equal to the roll’s total instead.

If the target is an Undead, and you have it regain Hit Points, it regains additional Hit Points equal to your Paladin level.

Extra Damage.name: Extra Damage
Extra Damage.condition: when you use Death Coil to deal damage
Extra Damage.description: When you use Death Coil to deal damage, the target takes extra Necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) whether or not it fails its saving throw.

Faithful Steed.description:

Ghostly Stride.description: The steed and its rider can move through other creatures and objects this turn as if they were &Reference[Difficult Terrain]. Both steed and rider take [[/damage 1d10 Force average]] damage if they end their turn inside an object.

Holy Deliverance.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power, granting the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Improved Death Coil.description: When you use Death Coil to deal damage, the target takes extra Necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) whether or not it fails its saving throw. Infusion of Light.name: Infusion of Light
Infusion of Light.description: Whenever you cast a spell that deals Radiant damage, you refresh the pool of healing power that fuels your Lay On Hands feature. Your pool of healing power regains a number of Hit Points equal to the total number rolled for the spell’s Radiant damage, to a maximum of five times your Paladin level.

Regain Lay on Hands.name: Regain Lay on Hands
Regain Lay on Hands.condition: When you cast a spell that deals Radiant damage

Lightbringer's Aura.name: Lightbringer's Aura
Lightbringer's Aura.description: Whenever you cast a spell or use Lay On Hands to restore Hit Points to a &Reference[Bloodied] creature within your Aura of Protection, the creature regains an extra 1d6 Hit Points.

heal.condition: When you cast a spell or use Lay On Hands to restore Hit Points to a Bloodied creature within your Aura of Protection

Oath of the Ebon Blade.name: Oath of the Ebon Blade
Oath of the Ebon Blade.description:
Wield the Power of Death Against the Scourge

The Oath of the Ebon Blade unites the free death knights of Azeroth. No longer directly under the Lich King’s control, they still serve Bolvar Fordragon—first as agents of the new Lich King, and later, after the destruction of the Helm of Domination, as troops devoted to stopping the Scourge’s spread.

Oath of the Holy.name: Oath of the Holy
Oath of the Holy.description:
Serve as a Beacon of the Light

The Oath of the Holy unites Paladins who nurture life and use the power of the Light for healing and support. They combine great piety and virtue with martial skill, aspiring to the highest standards of morality, service to others, and self-sacrifice.

These paladins share the following tenets:

  • Live your life in service to others of goodwill.

  • Do all in your power to ease the suffering of the innocent.

  • Let the Light shine through you to banish the darkness.

Runeforging.name: Runeforging
Runeforging.description:
When you finish a Long Rest, you can inscribe one of the following runes on a melee weapon you are holding, or you can transfer the rune to a different weapon. Whenever you gain a level, you can replace it with a different rune.

Blood. When you inscribe this rune on your weapon, and whenever you finish a Long Rest while the rune is inscribed on your weapon, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Paladin level. While you are wielding your inscribed weapon, you gain these Temporary Hit Points whenever you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points.

Frost. While you are wielding your inscribed weapon, damage from your weapon attacks, Paladin spells, and Paladin features ignores Resistance to Cold damage. When you make the extra attack of the Light property and hit while wielding your inscribed weapon, you deal an extra 1d4 Cold damage.

Unholy. While you are wielding your inscribed weapon, damage from your weapon attacks, Paladin spells, and Paladin features ignores Resistance to Necrotic damage. If your inscribed weapon has the Heavy property, the first creature you hit with it each turn takes extra Necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

Soul Fragments.name: Soul Fragments
Soul Fragments.description:
You harvest the energy of souls to fuel some of your special powers. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you gain a number of soul fragments equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one fragment); each soul fragment is a Tiny object in the form of a crystal. These fragments last until you finish another Long Rest, at which point they disintegrate. If you ever move more than 30 feet from a fragment, the fragment immediately teleports to you, appearing somewhere on your person.

If a soul fragment effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals your Ranger spell save DC.

The number of soul fragments you gain when you finish a Long Rest increases when you reach Ranger levels 13 (Wisdom modifier plus one soul fragment) and 17 (Wisdom modifier plus two soul fragments).

Using Soul Fragments. You can use soul fragments in the following ways:

Double Jump. You can expend one soul fragment to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFeatherFal]{Feather Fall} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplJump000000]{Jump} without expending a spell slot.

Soul Cleave. Once on each of your turns, when you take the &Reference[Attack] action, you can expend one soul fragment and replace one of your attacks with a whirlwind of soul energy. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Psychic damage equal to 1d12 plus your Wisdom modifier, and you regain Hit Points equal to your Wisdom modifier.

Regaining Soul Fragments. When an enemy you can see within 30 feet of you dies, you can take a Reaction to regain one expended soul fragment.
